title: Sea of Dreams Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
h1: Sea of Dreams Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
description_expanded: Sun, Sand and Style- Your 30A Getaway Awaits! Step into this hidden gem along 30A, where the community private beach is at the end of the street, and your own private pool awaits for sunny dips any time of the day. Fully updated with all the bells and whistles, this stylish retreat comes complete with a MOKE LSV, perfect for cruising the coastal streets in true vacation mode. Whether you're soaking up the sun, splashing in the pool, or exploring scenic 30A area in your MOKE, this is the ultimate blend of relaxation, fun, and beachy charm! HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Neighborhood deeded beach access; skip the crowded public access - Private pool and hot tub, can be heated for additional fee - MOKE included!- STAND OUT in this FUN, retro style LSV (refundable security deposit and signed liability waiver required to use) - 2 Beach cruiser bikes! -4 KING suites, 2 spacious living areas for hanging out - Sandpiper Welcome Tote included for all rentals - Private parking spaces - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS -**Optional Cancellation Protection**- Allows cancellation for ANY reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies paid returned ($200 fee applies at booking). - Pool Heat available when pool is below 80 degrees, November-April. The cost is $50/day. - Hot tub SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS Floor 1 KING Suite, TV, private en-suite bath (shower only) Living Room 1 and Kitchen/ dining area 1/2 bath Floor 2 Living room 2, TV KING suite 2, TV, private en-suite bath (tub/shower combo) KING suite 3, TV, private en-suite bath (shower only) KING suite 4, TV, en-suite bath (shower only) connected to bunk room BUNK ROOM (4 queen beds) Deeded Beach Access! This lovely 5 Bedroom, 5 bath Beach Home was professionally decorated, boasts a private Saltwater Pool & Hot Tub! Amazing location on the east end of 30a near multiple shops & restaurants. This wonderful home features a custom Chef's Kitchen complete with an ILVE gas range, Thermidor fridge and a pass through service window to the Summer Kitchen on the back porch. Other features include Hardwood & Tile Floors throughout, Custom Window Treatments, Visual Comfort Lighting, Quartz Countertops, a large secondary Family Room on the 2nd Floor & multiple bedrooms with En Suite Baths. The large Bunk Room is spacious enough for play and is sure to please the kiddos. Privacy abounds with an adjacent preservation area & a generously sized backyard by 30a standards. You'll enjoy endless days of Summer fun and sun in both your backyard oasis as well as at the nearby Deeded Beach Access. White's Gulfview is a charming and quiet neighborhood that exudes the Old Florida Charm and the laid back lifestyle that 30a is so well known for. Imagine being tucked away in your own peaceful and private beach home with approximately 150 ft of deeded beach access nearby as well as being extremely close to all the action that East 30a has to offer in Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach, 30 Avenue & more.
